text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: DECISION: Add a **bold, full-width focus ring** that appears immediately on keyboard tab, with a 3px solid outline in high-contrast color (e.g., #000 on light, #fff on dark). This ensures keyboard users see their position instantly without waiting, fixing the "where am I?" problem. Trade-off: the ring may feel intrusive to mouse users, but we’ll test it with reduced-motion users to confirm it doesn’t cause discomfort.
